commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+2' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Unai Simon to dive and make a save.
87' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
85' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
84' 3:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
82' OFF THE BAR! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
82' Ath Bilbao quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao) comes onto the pitch for Mikel Jauregizar.
81' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) makes a strong challenge and Jesus Manzano blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Ath Bilbao.
77' Ernesto Valverde prepares a substitution. Andoni Gorosabel is replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
77' Here comes a substitution. Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) is brought on as a substitute for Alex Berenguer.
77' The attendance is 63810.
76' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) squandered a big chance! He got to the rebound inside the penalty box but only placed the ball against the crossbar!
76' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the right post!

75' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) looks like he will send a long ball into the penalty box from the free kick and it is a good chance for one of his teammates who is good in the air to get on the scoresheet.
75' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
71' The Ath Bilbao players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
69' Substitution. Pablo Barrios will be replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
69' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) earns the yellow card.

66' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Marcos Llorente, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), who beats Unai Simon with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
64' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta and he is replaced by Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao).
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Unai Gomez as he is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
63' It's time for a substitution. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of Antoine Griezmann.
62' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Alexander Sorloth cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Here is a change. Samuel Lino is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid).
58' Today's match ends for Giuliano Simeone who will be replaced by Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid).
57' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
53' Ath Bilbao couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
53' Jesus Manzano blows for a foul after Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
50' Neat passing move from Atl. Madrid in order to create new attacking opportunities.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ath Bilbao.
42' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Jan Oblak has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
41' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
40' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
40' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
39' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

36' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
35' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) was quite harsh and Jesus Manzano didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.
29' The linesman signals that Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
28' A quickly taken corner by Atl. Madrid.
22' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
21' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
20' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
19' Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
17' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
16' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
15' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
11' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) receives a pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the left post. Unfortunately for him, Jan Oblak makes a great save to stop his effort.
10' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside!
5' Jesus Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao).
4' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
3' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Atl. Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ath Bilbao will kick-off.
Jesus Manzano will officiate today.
